$comment: Snapshot of the skills enabled on the claude.ai account of Pol4720.
Two kinds are recorded separately, because only one kind is portable:
- owned:   authored by Pol4720. Their source lives in this repository under
skills/ and can be reinstalled anywhere with scripts/install_skills.sh.
- builtin: provided by Anthropic. They are enabled per account at
claude.ai > Settings > Capabilities. Their source is NOT vendored here
— it is Anthropic's, and it is updated upstream.

owned.name: repo-audit-fixer
owned.summary: Audits an entire repository as a hostile QA engineer, security reviewer and staff engineer, fixes everything found, proves each fix, and delivers a LaTeX audit report into Reports/audit-<timestamp>/.
owned.status: in this repository; enable it on claude.ai or install it locally

owned.name: q1-paper-auditor
owned.summary: Audits a scientific paper as a demanding Q1 referee, verifies every number against the data and code, repairs LaTeX to zero warnings, and writes an audit report plus a response letter.

owned.name: thesis-auditor-fixer
owned.summary: Rigorous review and correction of CS/Software Engineering theses in LaTeX — produces exact corrections, not just diagnoses.
